tax_id.description: Tax identification / VAT / GST / importer number. Example: 12-3456789 | DE123456789 | AU12345678

address.description: Full registered address including street, city, country. Example: 456 Commerce Street, Los Angeles, CA 90001, USA

authorized_rep_title.description: Title of authorized signatory. Example: President | Purchasing Manager | Director

authorized_representative.description: Full name of authorized signatory. Example: Robert Lee

incoterm.description: Incoterm rule, version and named place. Example: FOB Shenzhen Incoterms 2020 | CIF Los Angeles Incoterms 2020 | DAP Hamburg Incoterms 2020

inspection.description: Inspection requirements, agency and timing. Example: SGS pre-shipment inspection at seller expense | Buyer inspection within 14 days of arrival | No third-party inspection required

bank_details.description: Beneficiary bank name, account number, SWIFT code. Example: Bank of China, Shenzhen Branch; A/C: 1234567890; SWIFT: BKCHCNBJ | Leave blank if not yet determined

governing_law.description: Governing law for the contract. Example: Laws of Hong Kong | Laws of England and Wales | Laws of Singapore | Laws of the People's Republic of China

payment_method.description: Payment method and terms. Example: T/T 30% deposit, 70% before shipment | Irrevocable LC at sight | D/P 60 days | Open Account 30 days

payment_timing.description: Payment schedule and due dates. Example: 30% deposit within 7 days of contract signing, 70% balance before shipment | Full payment by LC at sight

warranty_period.description: Product warranty period. Example: 12 months from date of delivery | 2 years from date of manufacture | No warranty

partial_shipment.description: Whether partial shipment and transshipment are permitted. Example: Partial shipment allowed, transshipment not allowed | Both allowed | Neither allowed

dispute_resolution.description: Dispute resolution method, institution and seat. Example: Arbitration under HKIAC Rules, seat Hong Kong | ICC Arbitration, seat Singapore | CIETAC Beijing

estimated_delivery_date.description: Estimated delivery or shipment date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM. Example: 2025-06-30 | 2025-07

estimated_production_date.description: Estimated production completion date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM. Example: 2025-05-31 | 2025-06

document_type.description: Select the type of trade document to generate. Enter exactly one of: Sales Contract | Commercial Invoice | Packing List | Certificate of Origin | LC Application | Bill of Lading | Inspection Certificate | Other

name.description: Full product name and model/type. Example: Wireless Bluetooth Headphones Model BT-500 | Wooden Office Chair Type A

currency.description: Transaction currency. Enter exactly: USD | EUR | GBP | JPY | AUD | CAD | CNY | HKD

quantity.description: Quantity and unit of measure. Example: 500 PCS | 1000 UNITS | 200 SETS | 50 CARTONS

packaging.description: Packaging details. Example: 10 PCS per carton, export standard carton 40x30x25cm, total 50 cartons

unit_price.description: Unit price (numbers only, currency stated separately). Example: 45.00 | 128.50 | 350.00

description.description: Detailed product description for customs and commercial documents. Example: Wireless stereo headphones with active noise cancellation, Bluetooth 5.0, rechargeable lithium battery

total_price.description: Total contract price (numbers only, currency stated separately). Example: 22500.00 | 64250.00 | 175000.00

specifications.description: Technical specifications, materials, dimensions, grade. Example: Material: ABS plastic + aluminum; Weight: 280g; Battery: 500mAh; Color: Black

production_date.description: Estimated or actual production date. Format: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2025-03 | 2025-03-15

product_category.description: General product category for customs research. Examples: Electronics | Furniture | Apparel | Machinery | Food Products | Cosmetics | Medical Devices

port_of_discharge.description: Port where goods will be unloaded at destination. Examples: Los Angeles | Hamburg | Yokohama | Rotterdam | Sydney | New York | Tokyo

target_import_country.description: Country where goods will be imported. Examples: United States | Germany | Japan | Australia | United Kingdom | France | Canada

tasks.name: draft_packing
tasks.description:
Using the customs regulations research and reviewed transaction data, prepare a complete Packing List in both English and Traditional Chinese (bilingual format).

PACKING LIST MANDATORY FIELDS:
1. Packing list number and date
2. Reference to corresponding Commercial Invoice number
3. Seller (exporter) full name, address, registration number, tax ID, contact person title and name, phone, email, authorized representative name and title
4. Buyer (importer) full name, address, registration number, tax ID, contact person title and name, phone, email, authorized representative name and title
5. Country of origin / Place of production: {place_of_production}
6. Country of destination
7. Port of discharge: {port_of_discharge}
8. HS Code
9. Product name and goods description
10. Package details: carton number, quantity per package, total quantity, net weight, gross weight, dimensions, total volume / CBM
11. Type and material of packaging
12. Marks and numbers on packages
13. Total number of packages
14. Total net weight and gross weight
15. Incoterm and shipment details
16. Authorized signature block (authorized representative name and title)

DEFAULT VALUES \ apply when the input is blank; insert directly, do NOT mark REQUIRES COMPLETION:
- Packing list number: PL-[YYYYMMDD]-001 (use today's date)
- Marks and numbers: if blank \ N/M (No Marks)

REQUIRES SUPPLIER INPUT \ mark only these when not provided:
- Net weight per carton, gross weight per carton, carton dimensions (if not in packaging field)
- Total net weight, total gross weight, total CBM

REQUIRES COMPLETION \ mark only these when not provided:
- Exporter / importer names, addresses, registration numbers, tax IDs, contact details, authorized representatives
- Product name, description, quantity, HS Code, port of discharge, place of production
